### 1. EU27, China and the US in 2025 (OpenDigger, natural year 2025)

| | Developers (total) | Active developers | Developer OpenRank contribution | Project OpenRank influence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| EU27 | 24.5 m (13.6%) | 5.58 m (20.5%) | 5,350 k (28.9%) | 182 k (6.6%) |
| China | 17.6 m (9.8%) | 2.34 m (8.6%) | 1,210 k (6.5%) | 551 k (20.1%) |
| United States | 30.3 m (16.8%) | 4.65 m (17.0%) | 4,237 k (22.9%) | 1,882 k (68.7%) |
| India | 24.6 m (13.6%) | 2.73 m (10.0%) | 899 k (4.9%) | 4 k (0.2%) |

Shares are of the sum over all countries listed (236 for contribution; influence lists only 30 countries). Contribution = OpenRank earned by developers located in the country. Influence = OpenRank of projects attributed to the country.

Largest EU contributors: DE 1,551 k (rank 2), FR 853 k (rank 6), NL 489 k (rank 9), PL 357 k (rank 12), ES 318 k (rank 15).

### 3. Chinese projects, initiators and foundations in the global leaderboards

Definitions. Projects: Chinese = listed in OpenShare's "China" scope that year. Initiators: Chinese = in the China scope with the same OpenRank as globally (foreign firms such as VMware or Yahoo appear in the China scope with only their Chinese projects counted, so they are excluded). Foundations: share = OpenRank of Chinese projects inside foundations (China-scope value) over the OpenRank of all foundations listed.
